item.content:encoded:
3rd Meeting of the CSCAP Study Group on the Situation in Myanmar

发布源: Council for Security Cooperation in the Asia Pacific (CSCAP) --Malaysia | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

The third meeting of the CSCAP Study Group on the Situation in Myanmar brought regional experts and CSCAP representatives together in Bangkok on 3–4 September 2026 to examine possible pathways towards a sustainable political resolution to the ongoing crisis.

Discussions centred on Myanmar’s future political architecture, including the future role of the Tatmadaw, relations between the Union Government and Ethnic Armed Organizations, possible federal or federal-inspired governance arrangements, power-sharing, national reconciliation, and prospects for political transition. The meeting focused on identifying areas of convergence that could underpin practical policy recommendations rather than revisiting competing political narratives.

A second major theme was ASEAN’s role in supporting a political resolution. Participants considered the future of the Five-Point Consensus, ASEAN’s comparative advantages and institutional constraints, and realistic diplomatic initiatives that the organisation could pursue as circumstances in Myanmar evolve.

The meeting also examined the wider regional and international strategic environment, considering how China, India, Japan, Russia, the United States and other external stakeholders may influence Myanmar’s political trajectory. Particular attention was given to opportunities for constructive international engagement while preserving ASEAN centrality.

The final session focused on translating these discussions into practical policy recommendation

item.content:encoded:
CSCAP Study Group Advances Regional Dialogue on Biosecurity and Health Security

发布源: Council for Security Cooperation in the Asia Pacific (CSCAP) --Malaysia | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

The Council for Security Cooperation in the Asia-Pacific (CSCAP) convened the second Study Group meeting on Biosecurity and Health Security in the Asia-Pacific in Singapore on 4–5 August 2026. Co-chaired by CSCAP Singapore, CSCAP New Zealand and CSCAP Japan, the meeting focused on strengthening regional preparedness and cooperation in response to a rapidly changing biological risk environment.

A key theme was the development of stronger biosecurity and health security frameworks across the Asia-Pacific. Discussions considered responses to infectious disease outbreaks and advances in biotechnology and dual-use research. Speakers discussed new initiatives in Asia-Pacific countries to strengthen biosecurity, including implementation of the Biological Weapons Convention (BWC), the International Health Regulations, and UN Security Council Resolution 1540. Participants also considered ASEAN initiatives on biosafety and biosecurity and opportunities to strengthen regional coordination, capacity-building and information-sharing. In particular, participants further discussed transparency and confidence-building measures (CBMs) that support the implementation of the BWC.

Another important theme was the potential contribution of scientific collaboration to an informal transparency mechanism. item.title: [Council for Security Cooperation in the Asia Pacific (CSCAP) --Malaysia] 15th Biennial CSCAP General Conference to be held in the Philippines in December
item.description: 网站专栏报告。作者: 智库研究员。这篇智库文章初次发表在Council for Security Cooperation in the Asia Pacific (CSCAP) --Malaysia官方网站上。
item.content:encoded:
15th Biennial CSCAP General Conference to be held in the Philippines in December

发布源: Council for Security Cooperation in the Asia Pacific (CSCAP) --Malaysia | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

The 15th Biennial CSCAP General Conference will be held in Manila, Philippines, from 1–3 December 2026. Under the theme “Regional Security Adrift? Anchoring Order and Stability in the Asia-Pacific,” the conference will bring together regional experts to consider the major strategic, economic and transnational challenges affecting peace and stability across the region.

The programme will address major-power competition and regional security, maritime governance and UNCLOS, the economic security–national security nexus, and the governance of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. It will also examine the intersection between transnational and geopolitical security challenges, as well as developments in nuclear weapons, arms control and nonproliferation.

Against a backdrop of growing strategic competition and pressure on established regional and international mechanisms, the conference will explore ways to strengthen an open, inclusive and resilient regional security architecture. The conference will focus on the roles of regional institutions and ASEAN centrality, confidence-building, crisis management, international law and practical security cooperation in supporting a more stable Asia-Pacific.

item.content:encoded:
Հայաստան․ Նազելի Վարդանյանի և Թեհմինե Ենոքյանի՝ կին բնապահպան իրավապաշտպանների նկատմամբ դատական հետապնդումների վերսկսում

发布源: Civil Society Institute (CSI) --Armenia | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

Մարդու իրավունքների միջազգային ֆեդերացիան (FIDH) և Խոշտանգումների դեմ համաշխարհային կազմակերպությունը (OMCT)՝ իրենց համատեղՄարդու իրավունքների պաշտպանների պաշտպանության դիտորդական կենտրոնի (The Observatory for the Protection of Human Rights Defenders)շրջանակում, «Քաղաքացիական հասարակության ինստիտուտ» ՀԿ-ի (ՔՀԻ) հետ համատեղ, լուրջ մտահոգություն են հայտնում «Լիդիան Արմենիա» հանքարդյունաբերական ընկերության կողմից կին բնապահպան իրավապաշտպաններ Նազելի Վարդանյանի և Թեհմինե Ենոքյանի դեմ նախաձեռնված նոր դատական վարույթների կապակցությամբ։

Փարիզ, Ժնև, Երևան, 9 հոկտեմբերի 2026 թ.— Ստորագրող կազմակերպությունները մտահոգված են, որ այս դատական վարույթները, նույն իրավապաշտպանների դեմ նախկինում իրականացված դատական գործընթացների համատեքստում դիտարկվելիս, ունեն հանրային մասնակցության դեմ ուղղված ռազմավարական հայցերին (SLAPP) բնորոշ հատկանիշներ և կարող են զսպող ազդեցություն ունենալ Հայաստանում բնապահպանական իրավապաշտպան գործունեության և հանրային շահին վերաբերող քննարկումների վրա։

Դիտորդական կենտրոնըև ՔՀԻ-ն կոչ են անում վերջ տալ դատական վարույթների այնպիսի կիրառմանը, որը կարող է վախեցնել, լռեցնել կամ հետ պահել բնապահպան իրավապաշտպաններին և հանրային վերահսկողություն իրականացնող այլ անձանց ու կազմակերպություններին հանրային կարևորություն ունեցող հարցերի վերաբերյալ բարձրաձայնելուց։

Նազելի Վարդանյանըիրավաբան և երկարամյա բնապահպան իրավապաշտպան է, ինչպես նաև «Հայաստանի անտառներ» ՀԿ-ի ղեկավարը։ Նա երկար տարիներ ակտիվորեն զբաղվում է Ամուլսարի ոսկու հանքի և դրա բնապահպանական, սոցիալական ու մարդու իրավունքն

Audio Book – Islamic Foundations of A Free Society

发布源: Afghanistan Economic and Legal Studies Organization (AELSO) --Afghanistan | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

AELSOApril 28, 2021Audio Books

About Islamic Foundations of A Free Society:Islam is growing rapidly both in its traditional homelands and in the West. Some in the West, view Islam with a mixture of fear and suspicion. However, it is also fair to say that there is widespread ignorance about Islam, and especially about its relationship to political systems and the economy. Is Islam compatible with a free society and a free economy? Is the fact that many Muslim-majority states do not have free economies or polities a result of an incompatibility between Islam and political and economic freedom, or does it result from an unfortunate series of historical events? What role has past colonialism played in encouraging Muslim extremism? Exactly what does Islam have to say about freedom in economic, political and religious life? This book, written by a range of Islamic scholars, sheds a great deal of light on these crucial questions. It is an important book for those in the West who need to understand Islam better. It is also important for those in Muslim countries who can influence the development of political systems and economic policy.The book is edited byNouh El Harmouzi & Linda Whetstoneand fortunately, now it is translated to Dari by AELSO and it is available as Audio Book in here and as PDF inhere.This Audio Book (Islamic Foundations of A Free Society) is presented for the visually impaired, or for busy people while on the road.

item.content:encoded:
CIRDAP Vision, Mission, Values, Functions

发布源: Centre on Integrated Rural Development for Asia and the Pacific (CIRDAP) --Bangladesh | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

The Centre on Integrated Rural Development for Asia and the Pacific (CIRDAP) is a regional, intergovernmental and autonomous organisation. It was established on 6 July 1979 at the initiative of the countries of the Asia-Pacific region and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations with support from several other UN bodies and donors. The Centre came into being to meet the felt needs of the developing countries at that time as an institution for promoting integrated rural development in the region.

From the original six members, CIRDAP has now grown up as a Centre of 15 member countries. The member-countries are Afghanistan, Bangladesh (Host State), Fiji, India, Indonesia, IR Iran, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Myanmar, Nepal, Pakistan, Philippines, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Vietnam.

Operating through designated contact ministries and link institutions in member countries, CIRDAP promotes regional cooperation. It plays a supplementary and reinforcing role in supporting and furthering the effectiveness of integrated rural development programmes in Asia and the Pacific.

To be a Centre of Excellence & multi-level platform for cooperation in knowledge transfer and capacity building for developing countries in integrated rural affairs for sustainable development in Asia and the Pacific Region.

Audio Book – The Adventures of Jonathan Gullible

发布源: Afghanistan Economic and Legal Studies Organization (AELSO) --Afghanistan | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

AELSOApril 2, 2021Audio Books

About The Adventures of Jonathan Gullible:Ken started writing economic commentaries for radio in 1980, but straight commentary from an academic economics was dry and uninteresting. No one paid any attention – and rightly so.Recalling the literary genius of Jonathan Swift’s Gulliver’s Travel and Antoine de Saint Exupery’s The Little Prince, Ken called upon friends to help spice up the radio spots with fantasy dialogues. Why shouldn’t economics be interesting? So Jonathan Gullible (JG) was born and interest among the radio audience soared! The ideas were outlandish and provocative so Sam Slom, President of Small Business Hawaii, proposed JG as a tool for economics education in the islands.The Adventures of Jonathan Gullible: A Free Market Odyssey has since been used for radio broadcasts, classroom discussions and debates, essay contests, film and theatrical productions, magazine and internet serialization, and animation around the globe.The book has won numerous awards and has been endorsed by renowned economists, publishers, and journalists: Milton Friedman, Walter Williams, Mark Skousen, Walter Block, Fred Foldvary, Steve Forbes, and John Stossel. It has been translated and published in more than 40 languages. item.content:encoded:
Tian Shan Policy Center

发布源: Bureau on Human Rights and Rule of Law --Kyrgyzstan | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

Tian Shan Policy Center (TSPC) is an international non-profit institution at the American University of Central Asia (AUCA) which focuses on research, policy advisory, capacity development and project implementation.

Since its establishment in 2011 TSPC promoted the study of Central Asia at the local and international levels and government institutions as the basis for improving the lives of people in new democracies.

TSPC specializes in research on migration (internal and external), sustainable development and environmental protection, human rights, democratic governance of Central Asia.

Alongside the strong evidence based research and policy advisory, TSPC organizes high quality trainings, conferences and events on pertinent topics in the region.

At the Second Regional Dialogue on Circular Economy in Central Asia, Kyrgyzstan was represented by members of Parliament, government institutions, and the business community

On 13-14 October 2025, the Second Regional Dialogue of Central Asian Parliamentarians on Circular Economy took place in Almaty, Republic of Kazakhstan. The event was organized by the EU SWITCH-Asia Programme (Policy Support Component) in cooperation with the Regional Environmental Centre for Central Asia (CAREC). The dialogue brought together parliamentarians, representatives of ministries, international organizations, experts, and business representatives from five countries of the region - Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan.

item.content:encoded:
CURRENT AND PREVIOUS RESEARCH FELLOWS

发布源: Bureau on Human Rights and Rule of Law --Kyrgyzstan | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

Visiting Research Fellow

September 2017 - July 2018

Abhi Goyal is a Fulbright Student Researcher from the United States, focused on the topic of informal communities and people who migrate in urban areas of the Kyrgyz Republic.

Informal communities are generally not included in demographic data about the Kyrgyz Republic, preventing organizations and the government from creating policies adapted to their situations. Abhi’s research focuses on the reason for these communities’ creation, their place in migration patterns, and their composition.

Before this research, Abhi worked at the USAID-funded Strengthening Results, Partnerships, and Innovations in Nutrition Globally (SPRING) Project, writing a social media strategy to reach urban households in the Kyrgyz Republic with nutrition information, as part of a broader urban nutrition strategy.

He has also worked at the SEEP Network, a non-governmental organization focused on addressing poverty, as well as Atlantic Media Company.

He holds a Bachelor’s Degree in International Relations from the College of William & Mary in Virginia.

E-mail:agoyal@email.wm.edu

Visiting Research Fellow, September 2016

Francesca Celi is a master’s degree student currently specializing in International Relations, with a focus on Central and Eastern Asia. She is a student in International Sciences in University of Turin, Italy. Her studies include politics, sociology and economics of Asia.

item.content:encoded:

发布源: AMBERD Research Center of Armenian State University of Economics --Armenia | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

Faculty of Economicsoperates from the establishment of the university (from 1975). The education process of the faculty is conducted full-time and part-time. Duration of studies of full-time Bachelor’s degree program is 4 years, part-time Bachelor’s degree program is 5 years, full-time Master’s degree program- 2 years and 1.5 years, and part-time Master’s degree program- 2 years. Full-time bachelor’s degree programs prepare specialists in economics and environment, namely:

"Economics" study program is part-time bachelor's degree program, and a bachelor's degree in economics is awarded upon its completion.

Full-time master's degree programs prepare specialists who gain the master’s qualification, namely:

"International Economic Relations" study program is a part-time master's degree program, and a master's degree in economics is awarded upon its completion.

item.content:encoded:
Faculty of Management

发布源: AMBERD Research Center of Armenian State University of Economics --Armenia | 抓取时间: 2026-11-26

The Faculty of Management of the Armenian State University of Economics was established in 1979 on the basis of the Faculty of Branch Economics. It was initially called Labor Economics and Organization and later became Faculty of Management as a result of the transfer of the specialty International Economic Relations to the Faculty of Economic Regulation and International Economic Relations. The courses at the Faculty of Management are full-time and part-time. Duration of studies of full-time Bachelor’s degree program is 4 years and full-time Master’s degree program- 2, 1.5 and 1 year, part-time Bachelor’s degree program is 5 and part-time Master’s degree program- 2 years. Full-time and part-time bachelor's degree program prepares specialists in management and service, namely:

Full-time master's degree program prepares specialists and awards them master's degree in management, namely:

The "Business Administration (Management)" degree program is a part-time master's degree program that awards a master's degree in management upon completion.

How can I access the regulations governing the academic process?

All official documents related to ASUE operations, including academic regulations, are published in the "Documents" section of the official website, availablehere.

What is the tuition fee reimbursement policy at ASUE?

Details regarding tuition fee compensation, student financial aid, and state or merit-based scholarships are available in the "Documents" section of the official websitehere.

How can I contact the ASUE Admissions Office?
